title: observability: token-level KV + cost/latency tracing dashboard and alert tuning
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds token-level observability for KV cache, cost and latency with tracing integration and alert tuning. Motivation: recent production incidents showed high token-level latency/cost spikes that were not visible in service-level aggregated metrics. This PR instruments per-request token metrics, exposes new prometheus metrics, ships a Grafana dashboard with per-model/per-route token cost and latency breakdowns and KV cache-hit panels, and adjusts alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage. Changes include runtime instrumentation emitting token_emitted_tokens_total{model,route,cache_hit}, token_latency_seconds_bucket{model,route}, token_cost_cents_total{model,route}, and new tracing spans for tokenization and KV cache lookup. Also adds a lightweight Prometheus exporter and Grafana dashboard JSON, updates helm values for sampling and retention, adds integration tests, and updates the runbook and docs. Rollout plan: feature-gated on dedicated and hosted, staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with metrics monitoring and quick rollback via feature flag. Related Linear: ENG-4567, ENG-4591. See SUP-1123 for customer repro. Cardinality note: metric labels limited to model, route, environment; tags normalized to avoid unbounded cardinality. Cost: estimated +0.5% cost from extra counters; mitigations include sampling and aggregation.
